newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani cotton rates steady amid select trade.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani cotton rates steady amid select trade.

text.p: Pakistani cotton rates remained unchanged on Saturday amid selective buying by mill owners, but dealers said prices could slip in the next few days because exporters were on the sidelines.

"Most mill owners built up their positions when rates were around the 2,000-rupee level," dealer Khushi Ram said. "For the remaining few, current rates are attractive, but they are going only for select stocks. For exporters these levels are still high."
In the kerb, NIAB-78 variety was traded around 1,900 rupees ($47.24) per maund (37.32 kg).
